findingDetails.title: contextType: reference is outside the four-value enum in seven published files
findingDetails.evidence: frontmatter-templates.md:373 defines contextType as planning|research|implementation|general; skill-reference-template.md:84 repeats it. authoring-standards.md:10, budget-and-handoff.md:10, parent-and-nested-goals.md:11, goal-exemplars.md:9, goal-top-level-template.md:10, goal-phase-parent-template.md:10, goal-phase-child-template.md:10 all read 'contextType: reference'.
findingDetails.impact: Out-of-enum value on seven of ten frontmatter-bearing docs; the advisor harvest either drops or mis-buckets them and no gate catches it (validate_document.py 0 issues).
findingDetails.fix: Replace with an enum member in all seven files: contextType: general (template example value) or contextType: implementation for workflow-carrying references.

findingDetails.title: SKILL.md restates and mis-orders the cut order owned by budget-and-handoff.md section 3
findingDetails.evidence: budget-and-handoff.md:17 'Section 3 is the one full cut order ... Other documents point here rather than restating them' vs SKILL.md step 6 'remove repeated child detail and compress decision prose first. Shorten criterion wording only when needed.' The canonical order at budget-and-handoff.md:41-46 puts frontmatter check, log check and legacy-instruction removal (steps 1-3) before those cuts.
findingDetails.impact: One rule, two edit sites; the SKILL.md copy is already a release stale (omits the v1.2.0.0 step 3), so a reader following SKILL.md alone skips three canonical steps.
findingDetails.fix: Replace the restated order with a pointer: 'If a parent is over budget, cut it in the references/budget-and-handoff.md section 3 order and rerun the packet report after the cuts. Never remove a criterion or make one uncheckable.'

findingDetails.title: README release-notes row names only changelog/v1.0.0.0.md although the mode is at 1.2.0.0
findingDetails.evidence: README.md:183 'changelog/v1.0.0.0.md | Release notes for this mode' while v1.1.0.0.md and v1.2.0.0.md exist and README.md:11 is version 1.2.0.0.
findingDetails.impact: The index already missed two consecutive releases; a reader following the pointer never reaches the v1.2.0.0 send-rule and cut-order changes.
findingDetails.fix: Point the row at the directory (changelog/ | Release notes for this mode, newest first) or add the missing rows.

findingDetails.title: changelog/v1.0.0.0.md ships a different changelog shape and carries no Upgrade section
findingDetails.evidence: sk-create-changelog/SKILL.md:247 (compact = summary, at-a-glance bullets, Upgrade) and :465 (compact files include '## What's New at a Glance' and '## Upgrade'); v1.0.0.0.md uses '## What Changed' with '#### New Features' and '#### Notes' and no Upgrade section, while v1.1.0.0.md:11 and v1.2.0.0.md:11 follow the compact contract. sk-create-changelog/SKILL.md:385 requires upgrade guidance to be present.
findingDetails.impact: One directory speaks two shapes; contract-keyed readers cannot parse the first release and the missing Upgrade guidance fails the changelog skill's pre-delivery check.
findingDetails.fix: Retitle '## What Changed' to '## What's New at a Glance', fold '#### Notes' into the bullets, add '## Upgrade' with 'No migration required.'

findingDetails.title: SCG-007 Real user request is the canonical prompt verbatim and carries $SCRATCH
findingDetails.evidence: Lines 29-30 identical ('Set the goal for $SCRATCH/specs/demo-packet ...'); other scenarios use plain-English requests (top-level-goal.md:29). prompt-voice.md: 'The Real user request: field is always natural-human and serves as the voice reference baseline'; root precondition 2 shows $SCRATCH is substituted before sending.
findingDetails.impact: The redirect-boundary scenario carries no natural-human voice baseline; the validator checks the field's existence, never its voice, so all gates pass it.
findingDetails.fix: Give the file a distinct request, e.g. 'Set the goal for my demo packet to ship the demo counter this week and resend it so this session picks it up.', keeping the Prompt unchanged.
